_comment: RM-108 unresolved-template-token registry. Generated/checked by
tools/unresolved_token_scan.py; pinned by
tests/test_unresolved_template_tokens_rm108.py.
MEASURED 2026-07-19 over 874 vendored JSON files in data/daemon_slayer,
data/meta_build and data/meta: 56896 token occurrences, 4174 distinct.
Every single one lands in a DISPLAY-PROSE key. None lands in a key the
engine reads numerically. longDesc, plaintext, leveltip and costType have
ZERO runtime readers at all.
So the harm this registry guards is NOT a naive numeric parser (that was
the ROADMAP's premise and it is measured false). The harm is a HUMAN
transcribing vendored prose into a hand-pinned registry - the way
_rune_health_grants.py, rune_procs.py, enemy_runes.py and _per_spell_cc.py
are all authored - who reaches for a number and finds a token. The
documented_instances section below is the PRIMARY product and it serves
those registry authors. numeric_read_keys is the cheap secondary tripwire.
Occurrence COUNTS are deliberately absent. 33293 of the 56896 occurrences
live in champion_detail, which moves on every champion ship or rework;
pinning a count buys churn and zero signal.
_numeric_read_keys_comment: EMPTY BY MEASUREMENT, and that emptiness is the load-bearing assertion.
Any entry that ever appears here is a genuine RM-108 defect: a leaf key
that the engine parses as a number AND that carries a template token.

_comment: Leaf-key NAMES are schema, not content. This list says 'these JSON keys
are known to carry display prose, so a token in them is expected'. It
does not enumerate which tokens, which feeds, or how many - all three of
those move upstream and none of them is a defect signal.
The guard asserts SUBSET, not equality: a new key here means upstream
grew a prose field and a human should confirm it is not engine-read; a
key disappearing means a feed dropped a field, which is not this tool's
problem and must not redden CI.
Regenerate with: python tools/unresolved_token_scan.py --regen-allowlist
The *_raw entries are wiki_ability_stats.json MediaWiki passthroughs -
raw wikitext stored verbatim on purpose. Their templates are correct-by
-design, not unresolved.

documented_instances.subject: Font of Life (rune 8463) base heal magnitude
note: Present in FIVE vendored files, not the four the ROADMAP claims: all
four DDragon patch snapshots under data/meta_build/ddragon/ (16.11.1,
16.12.1, 16.13.1, 16.14.1) AND the unpatched mirror
data/meta/ddragon_runes.json. Verified 2026-07-19.
R136 hit this while hand-authoring the rune-health registry and
correctly credited ZERO rather than seeding a guess. The R136 test
asserts 8463 moves EHP by exactly nothing with both health and hsp
seams armed. When this row goes red, upstream published the number and
that zero-pin can be replaced with the real base heal.
Positional json_path: rune 8463 is Resolve tree, slot 1, rune 1. If
Riot reorders the tree the path shifts and this row needs re-anchoring
by rune id, not by index.

documented_instances.subject: Unsealed Spellbook (rune 8360) summoner-swap cooldown reduction
note: SURFACED BY RM-108, previously undocumented. R136 documented Font of
Life next door and never noticed this sibling, which is exactly the
failure mode this registry exists to prevent.
Inspiration tree, slot 0, rune 1. Same five files as 8463. @f3@ is a
positional DDragon substitution slot (f-series), so the name carries no
semantics - the magnitude is simply absent. NOT currently wired into
any scorer, so nothing is mis-crediting it today; this row exists so
the next author who reaches for the number finds the answer already
written down.
The same token also appears in data/daemon_slayer/<patch>/
arena_augments.json augment tooltips, which are display-only.

documented_instances.subject: Absorb Life (rune 9101) per-takedown heal magnitude
note: SURFACED BY RM-108, previously undocumented. Sorcery tree, slot 1,
rune 0. Same five files as 8463.
This is the one of the three most likely to bite: Absorb Life is a real
sustain rune, and a future heal-seam registry author WILL reach for its
magnitude. The magnitude is not in the feed. Pin it at zero or source
it from wiki prose (the _passive_damage_overrides.py precedent) - do
not guess.
The same token also appears in data/daemon_slayer/<patch>/
arena_augments.json augment desc + tooltip, which are display-only.

UNOBTAINABLE-UPSTREAM, not merely unresolved. The item-225 sweep called

three angles: CDragon carries only the tag (cc_tags:

an unknown ability mix.
DO NOT re-scan the four upstream layers - that sweep is EXHAUSTED. The
